title: Shipping method selector
prompt: Build a shipping method selector for a checkout page. There are three options: Standard (free, 5-7 days), Express ($9.99, 2-3 days), and Overnight ($24.99, next day). Only one option can be selected at a time, and Standard is selected when the page loads. Each option must be exposed to assistive technology as a radio button whose accessible name starts with the option name. Below the options, show a line that reads "Shipping: Free", "Shipping: $9.99" or "Shipping: $24.99" to match the current choice. People must be able to change the choice with a mouse and with the arrow keys.
